SPIRE1-ENABLE_STS1_CONTENT.title: Enable StS1 Content
SPIRE1-ENABLE_STS1_CONTENT.hover.title: Enable StS1 Content
SPIRE1-ENABLE_STS1_CONTENT.hover.desc: Master switch. When OFF, all Slay the Spire 1 content from this mod is gated off while the mod stays installed.
SPIRE1-ENABLE_STS1_CHARACTERS.title: StS1 Characters
SPIRE1-ENABLE_STS1_CHARACTERS.hover.desc: Show the StS1 characters ("StS1 - X") in character select.
SPIRE1-ENABLE_STS1_CARDS.title: StS1 Cards
SPIRE1-ENABLE_STS1_CARDS.hover.title: StS1 Cards
SPIRE1-ENABLE_STS1_CARDS.hover.desc: Inject StS1 colorless cards into the shared reward pool.
SPIRE1-ENABLE_STS1_RELICS.title: StS1 Relics
SPIRE1-ENABLE_STS1_RELICS.hover.title: StS1 Relics
SPIRE1-ENABLE_STS1_RELICS.hover.desc: Inject StS1 relics into the shared reward pools.
SPIRE1-ENABLE_STS1_DUNGEON.title: StS1 Dungeon Content
SPIRE1-ENABLE_STS1_DUNGEON.hover.title: StS1 Dungeon Content
SPIRE1-ENABLE_STS1_DUNGEON.hover.desc: Register the StS1 dungeon acts, monsters and encounters. Does NOT change what a new run plays by itself - see the next option.
SPIRE1-USE_STS1_DUNGEON.title: Play StS1 Dungeon
SPIRE1-USE_STS1_DUNGEON.hover.title: Play StS1 Dungeon
SPIRE1-USE_STS1_DUNGEON.hover.desc: The next NEW singleplayer run plays the StS1 act sequence instead of the StS2 acts. Off by default so installing this mod never silently changes a vanilla run. Multiplayer is not affected.
SPIRE1-PURE_STS1_POOLS.title: Pure StS1 Pools
SPIRE1-PURE_STS1_POOLS.hover.title: Pure StS1 Pools
SPIRE1-PURE_STS1_POOLS.hover.desc: Custom character pools skip identical official StS2 cards and fill with our StS1-faithful implementations instead. Reward counts are clamped to what the pool can actually offer.
SPIRE1-DEBUG_SHOW_LOC_KEYS.title: Show Loc Keys
SPIRE1-DEBUG_SHOW_LOC_KEYS.hover.title: Show Loc Keys
SPIRE1-DEBUG_SHOW_LOC_KEYS.hover.desc: Append a localization key (e.g. SPIRE1-STRIKE.title) to every mod string in-game for debugging and console spawning.
SPIRE1-IGNORE_MP_MOD_DIFFERENCES.title: MP: Ignore Mod Differences
SPIRE1-IGNORE_MP_MOD_DIFFERENCES.hover.d: Force the handshake through mod-list and ModelID-hash mismatches (real game-version mismatch still blocks) and suppress the RitsuLib divergence popup. Fully effective only when both peers run this build; diagnostics still land in the logs directory.
SPIRE1-ENABLE_SKIP_NODE_BUTTON.title: Map Skip-Node Button
SPIRE1-ENABLE_SKIP_NODE_BUTTON.hover.des: Show a rescue button on the map screen: if you are stuck in a room, unlock map travel and click your next node. Uses the native vote pipeline — no desync risk.
